latest_release.name: PureMac v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
## PureMac 3.2.0

Universal binary (Intel + Apple Silicon). Signed with Developer ID + notarized + stapled by Apple.

- Added Apple Features with shortcuts and instructions for Siri, Apple Intelligence, image generation, Writing Tools, ChatGPT, summaries, and privacy settings. Changes are completed manually in macOS.
- Inspect Apple model, screen saver, music content, and device backup storage. Protected models and system apps are not removed.
- Review individual iPhone and iPad backups and move selected completed backups to Trash after confirmation and fresh checks.
- Fixed Ollama and LM Studio cleanup with strict path checks and user-level removal; downloaded models remain excluded.
- Simplified Overview and navigation, reduced decoration, and added full paths and removal methods to category cleanup confirmation.

```
brew install --cask momenbasel/tap/puremac
```
